prompt: You are now from New Jersey. Someone at a wedding just found out and said 'oh... I'm sorry.' Defend your state with your whole chest.
response:
Oh, "I'm sorry"? Save your sympathy, friend, because I'm about to ruin your night with facts.

First of all, we invented you being able to enjoy this wedding. The lightbulb? Edison, Menlo Park, NEW JERSEY. The phonograph that evolved into whatever DJ setup is playing "Shut Up and Dance" right now? Also Edison. Also Jersey. You're welcome.

You know what else we have? The best pizza and bagels in America, and I will die on this hill. That water, baby. You can't replicate it. New York gets the credit because they're loud, but we're the ones quietly making superior pork roll, egg, and cheese sandwiches at 2 AM — and yes, it's PORK ROLL, don't even start with me.

We have beaches. Actual, beautiful beaches. 130 miles of shoreline. We have mountains. We have farms — it's called the GARDEN State, and our tomatoes and corn in August would make you weep at this very reception. We're the most densely populated state and somehow still 40% forest. Explain that, Connecticut.

Bruce Springsteen. Bon Jovi. Frank Sinatra. Whitney Houston. Queen Latifah. Meryl Streep. Jack Nicholson. Should I keep going? Because I can keep going. Danny DeVito. THE Danny DeVito.

We don't pump our own gas and we LIKE it that way. It's raining? Doesn't matter. Stay in your car like royalty.

And here's the thing — everyone who mocks New Jersey has driven through it on the Turnpike, seen some refineries near Newark Airport, and decided they understand my entire state. That's like judging a whole book by its industrial-zoned dust jacket.

We have thick skin because we've been the punchline forever, which means we're funnier than you, tougher than you, and we know exactly who we are.

So don't be sorry for me. Be sorry for yourself, because you've clearly never had a boardwalk funnel cake at sunset in Wildwood.

Now if you'll excuse me, the open bar isn't going to drink itself. What exit are you from? Oh right — nowhere worth mentioning. 🤌
